main_text.l: est:addita comminatione,futurum,ut,ni si pœnitentiam agerent,post quadragesimum diem Niniueh cū suis incolis sub-uerteretur,uel eluuione,uel igne cœlitùs in eam, ut olim in Sodomam, depluen-te,uel terræmotu aut hiatu, uel deniq; a-lio aliquo modo.

Diligenter autem obseruanda nobis est συνᾳδολογ[?], ut ex cōminatione uelut parte,totum,uidelicet concionem de pœnitentia,recte colligamus. Qui enim non re[?] sipiscentibus exitium comminatur,idem ad Deum conuersis ueniam & malorum mitigationem pollicetur. Neq; consentaneum est, Ionam minis tantum egisse ad terrendos Niniuitas, cum pœnitentiæ præco esset. Sed præstat in iuniorum gratiam syllogismo rem compleĉti[?] in hunc modum.

Pœnitentiæ concio quatuor partibus constat. Primò, τῷ ἐλέγχῳ[?], quo peccato-rum rei conuincuntur, & peccata eis an-nunciantur: Isa.58. ac illustre eius exem-plum habetur Rom.1.2. & 3.cap. in quibus Iudæi & Gentes rei peraguntur iniustitiæ & impietatis. Secundò, τῇ παρανομί[?]-ea, quæ & agenda & omittenda præscri-

page.notes: Right margin, four lines beside the third paragraph: "Syllogismus," and "quo probatur Ionam nō solum minis egisse." (printed as "quo probatur / Ionam nō so-lum minis e-gisse."). Greek marginal note beside "nobis" read with doubt, as was the Greek in the text ("συνᾳδολογ"). The Greek of "τῷ ἐλέγχῳ" and "τῇ παρανομί-" is hard to read exactly. Line "non re / sipiscentibus" printed with a line break after "re"; the joining is uncertain. "compleĉti" has a mark over the e that I could not confirm. Long s is normalised as printed ("eft" written "est", "Ifa" written "Isa"). Printed "Rom.1.2. & 3.cap." is kept as printed.
